items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 8 at 2:38PM EDT until October 8 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...Up to one half foot of inundation above ground level
expected along shorelines and tidal waterways (7.0 to 7.2 feet
Mean Lower Low Water at Charleston).

* WHERE...Coastal Colleton and Charleston Counties.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...This could result in some roads becoming impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tide will occur around 7:08 PM today
at Charleston. Saltwater inundation will be possible 1 to 2
hours before and after high tide.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Visit water.weather.gov for additional water level and flood
impact information.

items.headline: Gale Watch issued October 8 at 2:39PM EDT until October 10 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 35 kt and seas
6 to 9 ft possible.

* WHERE...South Santee River to Edisto Beach out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From Friday evening through Saturday evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
